text: The fix for that (college football games on ESPN's FBS and FCS boards, which the Live tab couldn't see) is in v0.114.22, which was still downloading in your last screenshot (you had 0.114.21). After you install 0.114.22 or 0.114.23 (releasing now), open the Live tab: games should show scores instead of 'no score'. If many are still missing after that, send me a screenshot of the Live tab and I'll check the team-name matching for those specific games (and what ESPN returns for them).
